question: Which epithets identify the deity by his allure, enmity to demons, and emblem?
premises: The deity is the beloved of all beautiful women.
The deity is the enemy of demons.
The deity bears Garuḍa as his banner emblem.
inference: Together these epithets characterize the deity's attractiveness, adversarial role against demons, and distinctive iconographic mark.
uncertainties: The initial double consonant in ggaruḍadhvajaḥ is preserved as transmitted; its sandhi origin is not fully resolved here.
plain_english: Beloved of all beautiful women, enemy of the demons, he is the one whose banner bears Garuḍa.
